subject: full-information item factor analysis and MIRT

messages.author: b1ce292923e02c15
messages.subject: full-information item factor analysis and MIRT
parts:
Hi,

I'm master course student and have been studying full-information item factor analysis(FIFA) in R package mirt.

I want to check the relationship between the factor loading of FIFA and the item parameter of multidimensional IRT.

So, I read this article, http://www.jstatsoft.org/v48/i06/paper, and calculated;
a_ij = f_ij / u_j ...(1)
where f_ij is the factor loading for the jth item on the ith factor, and u_j is the square root of the factor uniqueness.

for example (the article p.10)
item1;
0.584= 0.504 / √(1-0.254)

so I could check (1).

However
I have been trying to analyze my test data(TIMSS2011)  in mirt (version1.5, http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/mirt/mirt.pdf) and calculate (1) ...I couldn't check (1);
the result don't meet (1)...

I am thinking that the article, http://www.jstatsoft.org/v48/i06/paper is not the newest and package mirt is renewed. So the estimation algorithm is also renewed?
I want to check the relationship between FIFA and MIRT.

I am writing my master's thesis...please give me your advice.

Thank you.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: full-information item factor analysis and MIRT
parts:
Did you divide the IRT slope parameter(s) by 1.702? This is no longer done automatically during estimation. As well, you may want check out the summay() function since these computations are done automatically. Cheers.

Phil
